_about: Every RAMP release, newest first. Each change says who it affects (who) and any feature it needs (requires). Entries with announce: true are shown once, as What's new, to the people they apply to. Add an entry in the same commit as the change; npm run guide:check validates this file and CI fails a RAMP push without an entry. See CLAUDE.md.

entries.title: Change log and update notes
entries.summary: A full history of RAMP updates for admins, and a short note for everyone about what changed for them.

changes.text: Change log in the Admin portal: every RAMP update in order, who it affects, and a CSV or JSON download.
After each update, RAMP shows you a short summary of the changes that affect you the next time you sign in. Just once.
Look back at recent updates any time with What’s new on the Guide page or in More.
RAMP remembers which tours and updates you’ve seen on every device, so they don’t repeat on your phone and computer.

slides.title: Change log
slides.text: Every update to RAMP in one place: what changed, when, and who it affects. Filter it, print it or download it.

entries.title: Getting-started tours and a Guide for every role
entries.summary: Slide tours with real screenshots for every kind of person, What’s new slides after updates, and Guide pages for the newer features.

changes.text: A getting-started tour with a screenshot on every slide opens the first time you sign in. Replay it any time from the Guide.
What’s new slides show the main features of an update to the admins they apply to.
Clients can open the Guide, with sections written for them.
New Guide sections for My work, coaching, account and billing, setup, the agency pages, the client portal and the platform console.
Guide and tour screenshots are retaken automatically after every update, so they always match the app.
The sign-in screen no longer says RAMP twice.
Pop-up windows no longer show a stray outline when they open.

entries.title: “Team member” instead of “assistant”
entries.summary: RAMP is for every new hire, so the wording on screen now says team member.

changes.text: Pages and messages say “team member” instead of “assistant”, including the agency, client portal, coaching and launch plan pages.
New placements are titled “Team member” by default instead of “Virtual assistant”.

entries.title: Workspaces, accounts and billing
entries.summary: RAMP can run for other companies: each gets its own workspace, plan and seats.

changes.text: Account and billing: your plan, seats in use, the organizations in your account and Stripe billing.
Owners can add another organization, such as a second company or brand, with its own people, training and settings.
New workspaces start with a short setup wizard: company details, what’s included and the first invites.
People shows how many seats you’re using.
If you belong to more than one workspace, switch between them from the company name at the top.
Link a client’s own RAMP workspace so their admins see your team members from inside it.
Clients with their own RAMP workspace see their team members, hours and invoices there.
Files uploaded to Resources are kept inside your own workspace.
Companies can ask for their own workspace from the sign-in screen with Start for my business, and get in once approved.
Client accounts console: approve or decline companies, give free access, a trial or a paid plan, set seats, and pause or close accounts.
Open any workspace as RAMP Support. Each visit is recorded in that workspace’s audit log.
Platform settings: trial length, default seats, the training library new workspaces copy and the Stripe plans owners can choose.

slides.title: Account and billing
slides.text: See your plan and seats, and add another organization to your account.

slides.title: Client accounts
slides.text: Approve companies that sign up for RAMP and give them free access while you test.

entries.title: Agency tools: clients, placements, hours, invoices and payouts
entries.summary: For placing team members with client companies: everything from the placement to the payout, and a portal for clients.

changes.text: Agency dashboard with revenue, margin and everything that needs you today.
Clients: company details, contacts, billing and an extra training track for each client.
Placements with bill and pay rates, an onboarding checklist, check-ins and a replacement guarantee.
Timesheets: approve or return weekly hours, or enter them for someone.
Invoices for hours, prepayments and setup fees. Print them or send them through Stripe.
Payouts for approved hours, with a batch file for Wise.
Tiers and agency settings: default rates, the checklist, check-in schedule, invoicing and the Day 1 agenda.
Launch plans: a guided prep plan, a timed Day 1 run sheet and a printable plan for every placement.
My work: log your weekly hours, add payout details, and see your placement, tier and pay.
Coaching: check-ins, onboarding checklists and training for the team members you coach.
Client portal: your team members, hours to approve, invoices and requests.
Advance invoices add the period’s prepayment before loose hours, so approved hours are never billed twice.
Team members only see a launch plan once it’s marked ready, and two people saving at once can’t overwrite each other.

slides.title: Agency tools
slides.text: Clients, placements, hours, invoices and payouts for team members you place with other companies.

slides.title: Launch plans
slides.text: A guided Day 1 prep plan and run sheet for every placement, shared with the client.

entries.title: The Guide
entries.summary: An illustrated guide to every page, with real screenshots and numbered callouts.

changes.text: The Guide: every page explained with screenshots, numbered callouts, steps and tips, showing only what you can open.
An admin guide for every setting, linked from the Admin portal.
Links in Resources that point to RAMP pages open inside the app.
The message box stays on screen while you scroll a chat.

entries.title: RAMP launches
entries.summary: Training, onboarding and HR in one place for new hires, mentors and admins.

changes.text: Sign in with your invitation, ask for access, and reset your password.
A welcome flow and a practice sandbox for your first sign-in.
Training made of short slides, readings, videos and quizzes. Your place is saved.
Tasks, a notebook, a vault for work logins, chat, resources and news.
Onboarding documents to fill in, upload and e-sign from your profile.
Team progress and reviews for mentors and leads.
Admin portal: organization, roles and departments, welcome flow, documents, training builder, assignments, people, metrics, announcements, resources, feature switches and the audit log.
Person records with documents, training and sign-in history, including IP address and device.
